note: Hand-written demo sentences in the style of CTI reports. None is taken from the TRAM train, dev or test split.

examples.title: Process listing
examples.text: The malware runs tasklist to enumerate running processes and sends the list to its C2 server.

examples.title: Credential dumping
examples.text: The operators used procdump to dump the memory of lsass.exe and later extracted credentials with mimikatz.

examples.title: Run key persistence
examples.text: To survive reboots, the loader writes its path to the HKCU Software Microsoft Windows CurrentVersion Run registry key.

examples.title: Spearphishing
examples.text: Victims received an email with a malicious Word attachment that dropped the first-stage payload when macros were enabled.

examples.title: Ransomware
examples.text: The ransomware encrypts files on local and network drives with AES and appends a .locked extension to each file.

examples.title: Data staging
examples.text: Collected documents were compressed into a password-protected RAR archive in a temporary folder before exfiltration.
